text: Gary Marcus Nov 05, 2026 ∙ Paid 93 9 20 Share I am old enough to remember when I posted this yesterday on X and got a huge amount of shit for it, from Sabine Hossenfelder and a slew of bots and tech bros: Gary Marcus @ GaryMarcus tech stocks set to crash now that people know that AI companies will no longer get a free ride. 2:31 PM · Nov 4, 2026 · 45.4K Views 62 Replies · 96 Reposts · 891 Likes And, yesterday, after I posted it, the market was actually mixed, split hard between chipmakers and neocloud companies like CoreWeave that got hit hard (much as I anticipated), and big companies like Amazon, Apple, and Google that didn’t, and instead got a bounce. One theory was that people were rotating out of the smaller neocloud companies, and into the bigger tech companies that could better weather the cash crunch: Another similar theory was the hyperscalers were up because (in light of the public resistance to data centers which came clear on Tuesday) investors thought that the hyperscalers might finally settle down on their wild CapEx expenditures: Nathan Calvin @ _NathanCalvin Fascinating - Josh at Epoch thinks that hyperscaler stocks are up because investors want company management to spend less capex dollars building AI data centers and the election results will force them to comply Josh You @ justjoshinyou13 @billyhumblebrag investors disagree with management on capex and want them to build fewer data centers 8:00 PM · Nov 4, 2026 · 2.76K Views 4 Replies · 1 Repost · 65 Likes Today looks pretty different.
